name: Luna-15 KT
about: Luna-15 KT (1969-058A, IKI/BABTS), launched 1969 Jul 13. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
